purpose: Teach: 埋まっ/労組/貸出/定休/代え/所存/営ん/取調べ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収品で保管庫が埋まっております
lines.en: Our storage facility is running over with seized evidence.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, administrative tone. Steady pace. No defensiveness—just stating fact. Slight formality befitting official report.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、労組とも円滑な対話を続けているそうですね
lines.en: Yes. I understand both the police and the union have been maintaining smooth dialogue.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Warm acknowledgment without fawning. Pace even and deliberate. The tone of someone working *with* rather than *for*.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、装備の貸出を整えております
lines.en: We're working to arrange an equipment lending system.
lines.style: Procedural but not robotic. Clear, direct. Slight emphasis on the practical solution. Professional courtesy—laying out what's in motion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、年末年始の定休状況をご周知ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. Thank you for notifying us about the year-end closure schedule.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, not performative. Warm but measured. The politeness of someone who notices when cooperation happens.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、担当を代えての対応も検討中です
lines.en: We're also considering reassigning the liaison officer for better continuity.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Acknowledges the idea without overselling it. Pace steady. The tone of someone open to adjustments.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、犯罪減少に努める所存ですね
lines.en: Yes. We remain committed to reducing crime in this area.
lines.style: Sincere commitment without theatrics. Steady, purposeful. The kind of simple conviction that doesn't need decoration.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域でパトロールを営んでおります
lines.en: We're maintaining regular patrols throughout the district.
lines.style: Clear update. Factual, confident. Even pace. The tone of someone reporting work already underway, not promising future action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の取調べが続いておりますね
lines.en: Yes. I understand the suspect interviews are ongoing.
lines.style: Attentive, engaged. Slight lean-in quality—showing he's tracking the details. Warm but not intrusive. The tone of someone who knows this matters.
